title: Calibration curve
summary: A response–quantity relationship used to calculate results within an established range.
zh_summary: 用于在已建立范围内计算结果的响应与量值关系。

title: Internal standard
summary: An added reference substance whose response can track specified shared measurement variation.
zh_summary: 加入的参照物质，其响应可跟踪规定的共同测量变异。

title: Limit of detection
summary: Detection capability defined by a procedure, decision rule, and error probabilities.
zh_summary: 由程序、判定规则及错误概率界定的检出能力。

title: Limit of quantification
summary: The lower level at which specified quantitative performance is supported.
zh_summary: 能够支持规定定量性能的低端水平。

title: Biological replicate
summary: Replication at a stated biological level, whose independence follows the sampling and intervention design.
zh_summary: 在明确生物学层级上的重复，其独立性由抽样及干预设计决定。

title: Batch effect
summary: Systematic technical variation associated with processing groups or acquisition order.
zh_summary: 与处理分组或采集顺序相关的系统性技术变异。
